decision_rule.score_formula: count five passing diagnostic checks: event window, rain rate, precipitation spread, displacement load, and surface-signal count

provenance.notes: Values are extracted from local CSX-055 records and image files; no network access is used.

criteria.description: Returns the exact JSON fields and final diagnostic state with the canonical answer, threshold_score of 5, and threshold_state of pass.
criteria.name: final_diagnostic_state
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for the correct final state with missing or renamed fields, and up to 1 point for a plausible pass label without the numeric score.

criteria.description: Computes 35 inclusive event-window days and 42.857 mm/day from the 300 mm rainfall lower bound over 7 days, with both thresholds passing.
criteria.name: rainfall_window_and_rate
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for one correct value, 1 point for correct units or rounding, and 1 point for the correct threshold comparisons.

criteria.description: Computes the precipitation-spread ratio as 134.505 / 66.978 = 2.008 and marks it as passing the 2.0 threshold.
criteria.name: precipitation_spread_ratio
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the three maxima, 1 point for the max/min formula, and 1 point for the correct rounded ratio or pass state.

criteria.description: Computes displacement_per_100mm as 160000 / (300 / 100) = 53333.3 people per 100 mm and marks it as passing.
criteria.name: displacement_load_index
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the displaced-people lower bound, 1 point for the formula, and 1 point for the correct rounded value or threshold comparison.

criteria.description: Evaluates VV change, embedding change, and true-color luminance delta against their thresholds and returns surface_signal_count of 3.
criteria.name: surface_signal_count
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 1 point for each correctly evaluated surface indicator and 1 point for the final count.

criteria.description: Combines the five checks into a concise flood-signal interpretation without adding a broad planning narrative or converting surface metrics into a mapped flood extent.
criteria.name: integrated_flood_signal_interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for correct integration with minor extra prose, and up to 1 point for a useful but incomplete interpretation.
